name: How long does a typical mantel installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical mantel installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a mantel installation can vary depending on the complexity of the design, the material, and existing fireplace conditions. A standard, straightforward installation might take a few hours, while custom-built or more intricate designs, especially those requiring modifications to the fireplace surround, could extend to a full day or more. During our initial consultation, we provide an estimated timeline once we understand the scope of your project, helping you plan effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mantel installation times vary from a few hours to a full day or more, depending on complexity and materials. We provide estimates after assessing your project.
